podcast.body: This "enduring" song presented an opportunity for the Academy to reward it in both the Record and Song of the Year categories at the 1989 Grammys. Although it did not win those categories, Chapman was "wisely give[n] the best new artist prize" for that year. "The Academy had an opportunity to reward Tracy Chapman's enduring fast car in both the record and song of the year categories."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: And the Grammy Goes to… Edition Part 1

podcast.body: Tracy Chapman's original recording, a classic single released in 1988 that reached number six on the Billboard Hot 100 pop chart. Following a high-profile duet performance with Luke Combs at the 2024 Grammy Awards, her original recording made a brief comeback on the Billboard Hot 100. "Back in 1988, her single reached number six on the big pop chart."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
